audience: merchants that take online payments with Qashier

useCases.title: See the open checkout sessions
useCases.text: List the checkout sessions, newest first, with status and amount. Find the sessions that wait for payment.

useCases.title: Check if an order was paid
useCases.text: Read one checkout session to see the payment status, the payment method and any refunds.

useCases.title: Create a payment link for a customer
useCases.text: Create a checkout session for one item with the amount and get the payment URL to give to the customer. Nothing is charged until the customer pays.

useCases.title: Cancel a payment link that you do not need
useCases.text: Expire an open checkout session so that the customer can no longer pay it.

useCases.title: Refund a payment in full or in part
useCases.text: Check the session first, then refund the paid amount or a part of it to the original payment method.
